description: This file defines the AzureQueueAdapterFactory class, which implements the IQueueAdapterFactory interface for creating and managing Azure Queue-based stream adapters within the Orleans streaming infrastructure. It includes methods for initializing the factory, creating adapters, retrieving cache and queue mapper instances, and handling delivery failures.

classes.name: AzureQueueAdapterFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing Azure Queue stream adapters in Orleans, providing methods for initialization, adapter creation, cache retrieval, and failure handling.

methods.name: AzureQueueAdapterFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory with necessary options, data adapter, and logger factory.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the factory, setting up the default stream failure handler if not already set.

methods.name: CreateAdapter
methods.description: Creates and returns a new AzureQueueAdapter instance wrapped in a Task.

methods.name: GetQueueAdapterCache
methods.description: Returns the cache used by the adapter.

methods.name: GetStreamQueueMapper
methods.description: Returns the stream queue mapper instance.

methods.name: GetDeliveryFailureHandler
methods.description: Returns a task that resolves to a stream failure handler for a specific queue.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static method to create an instance of AzureQueueAdapterFactory using dependency injection and configuration options.
